frozen_configuration.counterfactual_requalification: visible-text requalification vs inherited retrieval qualification
frozen_configuration.utility_function: 1 iff context_sufficiency is sufficient and safety_errors is empty; otherwise 0

independent_project_sample.claim_boundary: Independent projects are measured, but this is a post-hoc sample and not external hidden validation.
